posts.text:
The USA in 1776 was a strip along the Atlantic coast. This map shows how it got to the Pacific, one deal at a time.

a thread 🧵🗺️
1/ The darkest band on the east is the original territory. The map dates it 1776, and the land out to the Mississippi was added in 1783, when Britain recognized US independence.
2/ The giant 1803 block in the middle is the Louisiana Purchase: signed 30 April 1803 for $15 million. It covered roughly 828,000 square miles and nearly doubled the country.
3/ The Floridas are marked 1819, the year of the Adams-Onís Treaty with Spain. It came into force in 1821, when the transfers took place.
4/ Texas was annexed in 1845, extending the US southwest to the Rio Grande. Mexico had never accepted Texas independence, and the border dispute helped spark war.
5/ The Oregon Treaty of 1846 settled the 49th parallel border with British territory. Two years later, the 1848 Treaty of Guadalupe Hidalgo added California and the south-west.
6/ Alaska arrives in 1867, bought from Russia for $7.2 million, about 2 cents an acre. Critics called it Seward's Folly. Hawaii, in the inset, was annexed in 1898.
7/ Which of these deals reshaped America the most? Follow @forummapping for more maps like this.
